Triage: `pm:queue`, `type: Bug` (flaky test). Root cause and fix are both already pinned by the filer: the `waitFor` is bound to the rendered cell while the assertion is about a separately-resolving fetch — fix is to wait on the thing actually being asserted, not raise a timeout or move the file to `heavyDomTests` (AGENTS.md forbids both, per the filer). No decision pending.

Size/model suggestion: S, `mode:subagent`, `model: sonnet`.

Fresh live occurrence, recorded here rather than as a twin issue — it red-lighted an unrelated PR (#4552, a plugin-grid locale one-liner) on 2026-08-13.

**Where:** CI run `31680222020`, job `Test (shard 1/4)` attempt 1 — https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/31680222020/job/94383748499

**Verbatim:**

```
FAIL  dom  packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.dottedDimensionTable.test.tsx
  > renders a LOCAL-only table exactly as the server sent it, and issues the ONE read (#4330)
AssertionError: expected [] to deeply equal [ 'crm_opportunity' ]
- Expected
+ Received
- [
-   "crm_opportunity",
- ]
+ []
 ❯ packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.dottedDimensionTable.test.tsx:207:23
```

Shard totals that attempt: `1 failed | 4437 passed | 1 skipped`.

**Confirmed flake, not a break.** Re-running the failed job with **zero** code change (attempt 2, same head sha `426a4d3a`) went green: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/31680222020/job/94386051468. It also passes in isolation locally (6/6), and `main`'s own `Test (coverage)` job at `479cc7b4` — that PR's exact base — was green, so it only surfaces under the sharded PR runs.

**Mechanism, as this issue already states, confirmed from the source:** the case waits only on the rendered cell —

```
await waitFor(() => expect(firstRowCells()[0]).toBe('Education'));
expect(requested).toEqual(['crm_opportunity']);
```

— and the file's own amended-pin comment explains why that wait cannot cover the fetch: with no bundle mounted the display *equals the authored label*, so `relabelDimensions` returns the server's rows **by identity** and the cell reads `Education` on the very first paint. The `waitFor` is therefore satisfied before the async `GET /meta/object/:name` has pushed into `requested`, and the next line asserts an unsynchronized side effect. Under a loaded shard the fetch loses that race; alone on a quiet runner it wins. The sibling case two blocks up is exposed the same way — it asserts `['crm_opportunity', 'crm_account']` after the same single-cell wait, so it is the same defect with a wider target.

Suggested shape (not implemented here — out of scope for #4552): wait on the effect being asserted, e.g. `await waitFor(() => expect(requested).toEqual(['crm_opportunity']))`, keeping the cell assertion as the separate identity pin it is meant to be.

Second site of the same race, measured today while implementing #4683 (session `session_01RnQd8iMMUwXQEV1crFmQiQ`). Attaching here rather than filing a duplicate, so one fix closes the class.

`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.dottedDimension.test.tsx:269` — the sibling file of the one this card names — has the identical shape:

```tsx
await waitFor(() => expect(categoriesOf('bogus')).toEqual(['education']));
// Only the base object was ever asked for.
expect(requested).toEqual(['crm_opportunity']);
```

in `falls through gracefully when the relationship segment is not a relationship`. The wait is on the rendered category; the assertion is on `installMetaRouter`'s `requested`. Same failure text this card quotes:

```
AssertionError: expected [] to deeply equal [ 'crm_opportunity' ]
- [ "crm_opportunity" ]
+ []
 ❯ packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.dottedDimension.test.tsx:269:23
```

Same non-reproducibility profile, and measured on BOTH sides of my change so it is not that change:

- full `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/` with my guard applied: `1 failed | 461 passed` (the line above);
- same command with the guard ablated (`git checkout origin/main -- AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`): `58 passed (58) · 462 passed`;
- same command with the guard restored: `58 passed (58) · 462 passed`;
- the file alone: green.

So it is load/order dependent exactly as described here, and the remedy this card already prescribes — wait on the thing being asserted, keeping the rendered assertion as its own step — applies verbatim at line 269. Whoever takes this card should sweep the other `installMetaRouter` call sites for the same pattern rather than fix the two known lines.
